units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:1">Yoma I, 1</cite> <he>שמא יארע בו פ׳</he> because something might happen that would disqualify him for the service of the day.

<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:7">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא … יש במיטתי פ׳</he> is there perhaps, which God forbid, a blemish in my couch (an unworthy person among my descendants)? <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 1:19">Tosef. Mikv. I, 19</cite>, a. e. <he>מקוה פְּסוּלוֹ בעצמו</he> a bath (that has become unfit for ritual purposes) has its unfitness in itself; <he>בן גרושה … שפסולו באחרים</he> whereas the son of a divorced woman (married to a priest) owes his disqualification to others (his parents).

<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 1:19">Ib.</cite> <he>פסולו ביחיד</he> his (its) unfitness is caused by a single person; <he>פסולו בבית דין</he> by a court; <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:1">Mikv. III, 1</cite> <he>לעולם הוא בפסולו וכ׳</he> it remains in its condition of unfitness until &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:3">Zeb. VIII, 3</cite> <he>אין מביאין קדשים לבית הפ׳</he> we must not wittingly cause sacred meat to be brought to the place where the unfit things are burnt.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 10:7">Ib. X, 7</cite> <he>שלא יביא … לידי פ׳</he> for one must not cause T’rumah to become unfit; a. v. fr.
